expectedResult: Responsive pop-ins/wrapping preserve labels, values, and actions.
actualResult: The tablet List Report preserved filters, tabs, Create Bug, table rows, and row actions. The Object Page preserved its header and primary actions, and the Similar Bugs footer actions remained reachable. However, the Review Classification Suggestions button label was visibly clipped and Similar Bugs reason text extended beyond the dialog content edge instead of wrapping, so labels/values were not fully preserved.
reviewBoundary: This is a candidate responsive-layout failure, not an approved FAIL. DonHV must review and decide Jira/catalog disposition.
